Stake-weighted shred destination selection and Turbine tree computation.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_shred_dest_t` interface for computing Turbine shred destinations from stake-weighted validator data. It declares the data structures used to store destination records, stake counts, source validator state, and the mapping from public keys to destination indices. It also declares functions to format, join, leave, and delete the object, plus functions to compute the first Turbine destination and the child destinations for a set of shreds. The file also provides helper functions to map a destination index back to contact data, look up a public key, and update the current source validator index.
